description.text: This is an individualized programmes for anyone who wants to study Chinese in Shangha in part-time. With only 300USD, SICAS will helps you find suitable university to study Chinese. 100% refund if you are not satisfied.

duration.text: The Learn Chinese in Shanghai at SICAS School is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 0 USD/In total ￥ 0 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be between the age of 18 to 65years old. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 3. Applicants must be in good health. 4. High school graduate or equivalent or above. 5. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university; 6. Record of good conduct 7. All language levels are available 8. Applicant who is under 18 years old needs to submit the guardian's guarantee
